prompt: If the contributor had booked by Friday morning, which suggestion would address the wish to have the piano heard on air and still follow the live-chat sound rules?
promptZh: 假設投稿人星期五早上就完成預約，哪項建議能兼顧讓鋼琴聲播出的願望與現場訪談的聲音規則？

options.text: Speak live with the host; play the short tune quietly during the conversation, as noted in the booking.
options.zh: 和主持人現場交談；如預約備註所寫，在談話中以較小音量播放短曲。
options.whyZh: 事先備註正確，但訪談進行中不可用音樂墊底，即使小聲也不行。

options.text: Speak live with the host; offer the short tune after the chat without mentioning it in the booking.
options.zh: 和主持人現場交談；結束後再提出播放短曲，不事先寫在預約備註。
options.whyZh: 播放時機正確，但想播的聲音須事先填入，讓電台有時間審查。

options.text: Mention the short tune in the booking and ask the host to play it after the conversation.
options.zh: 預約時註明這段短曲，詢問主持人能否在談話結束後播放。
options.whyZh: 本人盼鋼琴曲能播出，但不必如原提議在談話時播放；可先在備註提出，談完才播。

options.text: Mention the short tune in the booking and ask the host to play it in place of the conversation.
options.zh: 預約時註明這段短曲，詢問主持人能否以它代替談話。
options.whyZh: 備註雖正確，但現場形式本身必須有兩分鐘的對談，不是單播音樂。

explanationZh: 本人盼鋼琴曲能播出，但不必如原提議在談話時播放；可先在備註提出，談完才播。
evidence: A live chat is a two-minute conversation with our host; book it by Friday at noon. / For live chats, the host can play a short sound after the conversation, but not underneath it. / Mention any sound you want played in the booking note so we can check it in advance. / The piano tune is my own, and I was hoping the station could play it while I tell the story.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: A live chat is a two-minute conversation with our host; book it by Friday at noon.
For live chats, the host can play a short sound after the conversation, but not underneath it.
Mention any sound you want played in the booking note so we can check it in advance.
The piano tune is my own, and I was hoping the station could play it while I tell the story.

vocabulary.note: 表示在某項活動前先完成準備。
